subject.title: fix(agent): recover disconnected gateway runs before rerunning

question: Should `openclaw agent` change its default accepted-disconnect behavior to reattach and replay the Gateway-owned run before retaining the existing isolated embedded fallback?
rationale: Both paths are technically plausible, but they make different user-visible promises about latency, streaming, authoritative results, duplicate model/tool effects, and `--deliver` behavior; source review cannot select that product contract.

options.title: Approve reattach-first recovery
options.body: Adopt the branch’s recover-then-fallback order, retaining automatic isolated fallback only after recovery cannot establish an outcome.

options.title: Keep immediate isolated fallback
options.body: Retain current main behavior and close or narrow this PR because predictable prompt local output remains the preferred CLI contract.

options.title: Approve a scoped policy
options.body: Apply reattach-first only to a defined mode such as `--deliver`, with explicit tests and documentation for the remaining interactive path.

recommendation.title: Approve reattach-first recovery
recommendation.body: Adopt the branch’s recover-then-fallback order, retaining automatic isolated fallback only after recovery cannot establish an outcome.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the current closed/timeout fallback boundary and is the strongest available owner signal for the intended replacement policy.
